ValidationRule.description: Work email must start with first initial + last name (lowercase) and the employee name must be INITCAP-ed 'First Last'.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Work_Email__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(First_Name__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Last_Name__c)), OR( NOT(BEGINS(Work_Email__c, LOWER(LEFT(First_Name__c, 1) & SUBSTITUTE(Last_Name__c, ' ', '')))), Name <> INITCAP(LOWER(First_Name__c & ' ' & Last_Name__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Work Email or Name does not follow first-initial+lastname convention.
